blocker_detail: The skill's entire workflow is built on executing commands: authenticated `gh` CLI calls (`gh pr view`, `gh pr checks`, `gh run view --log-failed`, `gh api ...`), running Python scripts via `uv run scripts/fetch_pr_checks.py` / `fetch_pr_feedback.py` / `monitor_pr_checks.py` / `reply_to_thread.py`, and shell/git commands (`git add`, `git commit -m`, `git push`) to push fixes and loop until CI passes. I could only read the SKILL.md text and, at most, simulate JSON output by hand-authoring a fake file, which would not reflect a real PR's real CI/review state and would not be the skill's actual deliverable (a merged, CI-green PR). This is not a text-editing task; it requires invoking gh, uv, python, and git as executables against a live authenticated GitHub session, which is outside the office-assistant's read/write/edit-text-files and web-fetch/search capability set. I stopped here rather than fabricating command output or working around the restriction.
